name: report_inbound_callback
description: Use on an inbound call when a hospital is calling back about a referral, once you know which hospital it is and what they want to tell the doctor.
pre_call_message: Thank you, passing this to the doctor.

hospital_name.description: The hospital they are calling from.

referral_code.description: The reference if they have it, like R4821. Leave empty if not given.

message.description: Their message for the doctor, in a few words.

from_number.description: The caller's number. Filled in automatically; never ask for it.
